$comment: The render context for templates/display-manager/sddm.conf.j2. One name: the SDDM display server. The DM TYPE, packages, the Pixie pin and service enablement stay in the installer (spine AD-9) — only the file body is an asset.
title: display-manager/sddm.conf.j2 — render context
description: The single value the SDDM config reads: DisplayServer (wayland or x11).

display_manager_sddm_display_server.description: SDDM's DisplayServer value. Enumerated because these are the two values the directive accepts; the consumer's default is `wayland` (the no-X11-GPU-grab choice the template documents).

x-render-contract.no_default_on_required: No `default(` fallback: the display server is a login-path decision, and a silently defaulted value is exactly the kind of broken-greeter state this file cannot detect.
x-render-contract.assets_scope: No mode, ownership, service name or package list here (spine AD-9): the installer renders this at 0644 with become and owns enablement.
